    n = len(x)
    mx, my = x.mean(), y.mean()
    ss_xy = np.sum((x - mx) * (y - my))
    ss_xx = np.sum((x - mx) ** 2)
    ss_yy = np.sum((y - my) ** 2)
    if ss_xx == 0 or ss_yy == 0:
        return 0, 0, 0
    slope = ss_xy / ss_xx
    intercept = my - slope * mx

    return r2, slope, intercept
